What the meme means

Arthur shows up where he doesn't fit. Five-star lobbies, valet lines full of supercars, red carpets. Everyone around him looks expensive and serious. He looks like Arthur.

And he doesn't care. That's the whole joke and the whole point: own your style, especially when people stare.

Post your Arthur moment. The first day at a new job, walking into the group chat after a bad call, buying the dip while everyone panics. Use a caption on the right, or write your own.

Make your own Arthur

Arthur was made with AI, and you can make a character of your own the same way: design them once, keep their face consistent, then drop them into any scene and let them walk.

  1. Design the character

    Write a detailed description: age, face, hair, outfit, and one absurd signature detail people will remember. Arthur's is the shoes.

    Generate a few full-body pictures in an image model and pick the best one.

    A sharp, front-facing, full-body photo gives the best results later.

  2. Lock the look

    Make the character consistent so the face doesn't change from video to video. Tools like Higgsfield's Soul ID let you train a character from a handful of images.

    Generate 4–6 angles of the same character before you move on.

  3. Swap them into a video

    Pick a clip with the motion you want, like someone walking out of a hotel, or film yourself. Upload the video and your character's photo to a character-swap tool such as Higgsfield Recast, Viggle or Kling.

    It replaces the whole person, body and motion included, not just the face.

    Short clips with one clearly visible person and good light swap best.

  4. Finish and post

    Trim it to a few seconds, add sound and a caption, and label it as AI-made. Post the same character in new places again and again. That repetition is what turns a character into a meme.

Starter prompt

Full-body photo of an eccentric elderly gentleman with a wild white cloud of hair, slim build, royal purple suit with an extra-long coat, white socks and absurdly long black patent pointed shoes, gold watch, holding a blue folder, standing outside a luxury hotel entrance, natural daylight, street-style photography, 9:16.

Play fair: swap in characters you created, not real people's faces without their consent. Label your videos as AI-generated, and use your own footage or short clips you have the right to use.
